slides.sub: Moving to Dover? 3 coffee stops, 2 on W. Blackwell St.
slides.source: Shop Morris County, Things to Do in Dover (updated Oct. 2026)

slides.title: Kaprichos Cafe
slides.body: A Colombian cafe, bakery and restaurant with specialty coffee and a full breakfast menu. Opens at 6 AM every day.

slides.title: Tierras y Sabores
slides.body: A Colombian breakfast spot on the same street. It opens at 6 AM Monday to Saturday and 7 AM on Sunday.

slides.title: The Good Bean
slides.body: Its beans are roasted for the shop, with certified organic and single-origin options. Opens 7:30 AM on Saturday.

slides.title: Your Dover coffee stops
slides.tip: Before you make an offer, walk Blackwell and Sussex streets on a weekend morning.
slides.source: Shop Morris County, Things to Do in Dover (updated Oct. 2026)

caption:
Moving to Dover? This is the part listing photos never show you: where you'll get coffee on a Saturday.

Kaprichos Cafe at 30 W. Blackwell St is a Colombian cafe and bakery with specialty coffee, open from 6 AM every day. Tierras y Sabores, also on W. Blackwell St at No. 33, serves Colombian breakfast from 6 AM (7 AM on Sunday). The Good Bean at 60 N. Sussex St roasts its beans for the shop and opens at 6:30 AM on weekdays and 7:30 AM on Saturday.

Before you make an offer, walk Blackwell and Sussex streets on a weekend morning.
